## Overview

This 2026-09-15 Online banking Thailand for iOS page is an integration chooser. It directs readers to iOS Drop-in or Components child guides and to main Sessions/Advanced integration guides. It does not itself provide method setup, API/SDK version, request, redirect or outcome instructions. [[adyen]] [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- The page presents Drop-in as an all-in-one UI route and names `InstantPaymentComponent` for the Components route. Those labels describe choices, not complete payment mechanics or proof of a completed payment. See raw lines 19–27.
- It says to create the main integration before adding Online banking Thailand, and links iOS Drop-in and Components guides for both Sessions and Advanced flows. The linked child and base guides provide their own prerequisites and behavior; this chooser does not set a version floor or country/currency fields. See raw lines 29–36.
